title: SmartAttend Official Release (v1.0.2)
releaseNotes: Quick attendance preset is now 30 seconds plus 30 seconds.
New attendance sessions default to 45 seconds plus 75 seconds.
Official Release of SmartAttend with modern glassmorphism UI
Streamed In-App Update system with SHA-256 integrity checks
Step-by-step Android installation and source permission guidance
Real-time attendance management and student verification

history.title: SmartAttend Initial Release
releaseNotes: Initial release of SmartAttend Attendance Management System.
Role-based portals for Admins, Lecturers, and Students.
On-device biometric and QR attendance workflow.
